The comparative metabolomic analysis of two contrasting genotypes of Brassica napus, one with high cadmium (Cd)-accumulation and one with low Cd-accumulation, revealed that the Cd-tolerant genotype CB671 responds to Cd stress by increasing the production of compatible solute, sugars, vitamin C, jasmonates and ethylene, while reducing IAA abundance and increasing serotonin levels.
